name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 27 - Am 132
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 27 a. Highlights the fact that the Hungarian Government conducted a series of negotiations with the Commission in order for Hungary to be able to access the cohesion funds to which it is rightfully entitled; notes that, as a result of the dialogue, Hungary undertook to fulfil a package of measures; condemns the fact that the Commission has subjected the transfer of development funds to Hungary to ever stricter conditions; demands that the Hungarian cohesion envelope be protected from the risk of being redirected to other policies or to other countries and demands that the Commission disburse the financial resources immediately; expects the new Commission to review the application of the rule of law conditionality and to stop the politically selected ideological blackmailing of Member States;
